label: Ability damaged
summary: Ability scores are temporarily reduced; recalculate affected modifiers. Zero scores can incapacitate or kill.

label: Ability drained
summary: Ability scores are permanently reduced; restoration usually requires magic. Recalculate affected modifiers.

label: Blinded
summary: Cannot see; half movement, −2 AC, no Dexterity bonus to AC, and 50% miss chance. Sight-based checks fail.

label: Blown away
summary: Wind knocks ground creatures prone and rolls them backward; flyers are blown away. Resolve distance and damage.

label: Checked
summary: Wind prevents forward movement; a flying creature can also be driven backward.

label: Confused
summary: Determine behavior each turn using the confusion table; attacks can redirect the next turn’s behavior.

label: Cowering
summary: Frozen by fear: no actions, −2 AC, and no Dexterity bonus to AC.

label: Dazed
summary: Cannot take actions; this condition alone does not reduce AC.

label: Dazzled
summary: Apply −1 to attacks and to Search and Spot checks.

label: Dead
summary: Cannot act or recover through ordinary healing; returning to life requires an appropriate effect.

label: Deafened
summary: Cannot hear; Listen checks fail, initiative takes −4, and verbal spells have a 20% failure chance.

label: Dehydrated
summary: Thirst can cause nonlethal damage and fatigue. Recovery requires water; resolve the exposure rules.

label: Disabled
summary: Half movement; choose one move or standard action, not both. Strenuous actions can cost 1 HP.

label: Diseased
summary: Use the particular disease’s saves, incubation, damage, and recovery rules; there is no universal penalty.

label: Dying
summary: Unconscious and unable to act; resolve stabilization and round-end HP loss unless already stable.

label: Energy drained
summary: Each negative level reduces attacks, saves, checks, effective level, and HP; spellcasters also lose spell capacity.

label: Entangled
summary: Half movement; no running or charging, −2 attacks, −4 Dexterity. Casting requires a concentration check.

label: Exhausted
summary: Half movement and −6 to Strength and Dexterity; sufficient rest reduces this to fatigue.

label: Fascinated
summary: Attend to the source instead of acting; reactive checks take −4. Threats can end the effect.

label: Fatigued
summary: Cannot run or charge; Strength and Dexterity take −2. Further fatigue can cause exhaustion.

label: Flat-footed
summary: Dexterity bonus to AC is unavailable, and attacks of opportunity are normally unavailable.

label: Frightened
summary: Flee if possible; attacks, saves, skill checks, and ability checks take −2.

label: Grappled
summary: Grappling restricts actions and threatened squares; lose Dexterity to AC against opponents outside the grapple.

label: Helpless
summary: Treat Dexterity as 0; melee attackers gain +4. Coup de grace may be possible.

label: Incorporeal
summary: Nonmagical attacks generally cannot harm you; many magical attacks have a 50% failure chance. Check exceptions.

label: Invisible
summary: Unseen; attacks against sighted foes gain +2 and ignore their Dexterity bonus to AC. Concealment applies.

label: Knocked down
summary: Wind makes ground creatures prone; flying creatures are pushed backward instead.

label: Nauseated
summary: Only one move action per turn; no attacking, casting, or concentrating.

label: Panicked
summary: Drop held items and flee; saves and checks take −2. If escape is impossible, cower.

label: Paralyzed
summary: No physical actions; effective Strength and Dexterity are 0. Purely mental actions remain possible.

label: Petrified
summary: Transformed to stone and unconscious. Damage or missing pieces can matter when restored.

label: Pinned
summary: Immobilized in a grapple, but not automatically helpless. Resolve the restricted grapple actions.

label: Poisoned
summary: Resolve the specific poison’s saving throws and initial/secondary effects; penalties vary by poison.

label: Prone
summary: −4 melee attacks; AC −4 against melee and +4 against ranged. Standing uses a move action and can provoke.

label: Rebuked
summary: Rebuked undead cower, and attacks against them gain +2 while the rebuke lasts.

label: Shaken
summary: Apply −2 to attacks, saves, skill checks, and ability checks.

label: Sickened
summary: Apply −2 to attacks, weapon damage, saves, skill checks, and ability checks.

label: Stable
summary: No longer losing HP each round from dying; usually still unconscious. Resolve ongoing recovery separately.

label: Staggered
summary: Choose one move or standard action per round, not both; no full-round actions.

label: Stunned
summary: Drop held objects and take no actions; AC takes −2 and loses its Dexterity bonus.

label: Turned
summary: Turned undead flee for 10 rounds; when unable to flee, they cower.

label: Unconscious
summary: Cannot act and is helpless; resolve the cause and recovery requirements.
